title.zh: 卡 B-1：NP5-01a RE-2 一般项修复（A-2 addenda 版本化 + policy_scan 引用块豁免）+ B 批肌腱 78 站点 source 级（零 GPU）
title.en: Card B-1: NP5-01a RE-2 general-item fixes (A-2 addenda versioning + policy_scan quote-block exemption) + B batch tendon 78 sites source-level (zero GPU)

intent.zh: 第一节承接 RE-2 复核 2 条一般项 + 1 低 + 2 观察：①A-2 `addenda.md` 恢复 v1 字节（0ba40a0b/2,030），修正内容版本化为 `addenda-v2.md`（写 supersedes + 修正原因），manifest 重算，RE-2 evidence 加指针并更正 `policy_tool.landed` 时点（工具实际由 e5315d95 落）、记录 mass_multiply 18 属 A-3、设备行级与逐站点粒度混用说明；②`policy_scan` 加显式引用块豁免（标记块 + 块内撤回/supersede 声明才豁免；未标记/无声明/未闭合一律命中；引用必须逐字原文，禁止拆写规避），加构造自测，入仓版本更新并记 sha，docstring 写用法与人工复核要求；A-2 addenda-v2 使用标记引用块。第二节 B-1：B 批 7 组（fixed_tendon 7 / spatial_tendon 20 / tendon 10 / tendon_wrap 9 / tendon_velocity 7 / tendon_passive 12 / joint_passive 13）共 78 站点 source 级对照：类型映射 + 表达式级分类（六类词表，双侧 file:line，not-decidable 缺因），自检 78 站点/pending=0/词表合法/policy 扫描 0 命中；NP5-01a 累计 139+78=217。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Section 1 fixes RE-2 review findings: (1) restore A-2 addenda.md to v1 bytes (0ba40a0b/2030), version the corrected content as addenda-v2.md (supersedes + reason), recompute manifest, add RE-2 evidence pointer and correct policy_tool.landed timing (tool actually landed at e5315d95), record mass_multiply 18 as A-3 scope and device-row vs per-site granularity note; (2) add explicit quote-block exemption to policy_scan (marked block with withdrawal/supersede declaration only; unmarked, undeclared or unclosed blocks still hit; quotes must be verbatim, no split-writing evasion), add constructed self-tests, update landed tool and record sha, document usage and manual review in docstring; A-2 addenda-v2 uses the marked quote block. Section 2: B batch 78 sites (7 groups) source-level comparison: type mapping + expression classification, six-category vocabulary, bilateral file:line, not-decidable reasons; selfcheck 78 sites / pending=0 / vocabulary / policy scan 0 hits; NP5-01a cumulative 139+78=217. Zero GPU/window.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-re2/`：evidence.json 更新 A-2 addenda-v2 指针（含 superseded v1 sha）、`policy_tool.landed` 时点更正（e5315d95）、`mass_multiply 18 属 A-3` 记录、粒度混用说明；README append 更正节；`manifest.txt` 重算。`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-policy-scan/`：新增 `addenda.md` 记录工具版本化更新（新 sha/bytes/自测数与引用块豁免）并重算 manifest。

`scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py`：显式引用块豁免（标记块内含撤回/supersede 声明才豁免；未标记、无声明、未闭合均照常命中；拆写变体仍命中），构造自测全 PASS（覆盖标记块=0/未标记≥1/无声明≥1/未闭合≥1/拆写变体命中/块外命中），docstring 写标记用法、逐字原文要求与人工复核；`--self-test` 实跑结果与 sha/bytes 记入 B-1 evidence。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a2/`：`addenda.md` 恢复 v1 原字节（sha256 `0ba40a0bf907b465fd21b81cb064be04e57162f5346b75fb3a6a09b8a457ee62` / 2,030 B）；新增 `addenda-v2.md`（头部 `supersedes: addenda.md@0ba40a0b…` + 修正原因；撤回 5 处表述含逐字原文引用块 `<!-- policy-scan:quote:start/end -->`；r2 归因更正/重扫；L1 时点更正；观察项）；`manifest.txt` 重算。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-b1/`：evidence.json（78 站点、7 组、类型映射 + 表达式分类 + 双侧 file:line、六类词表、category extras、not-decidable 六类缺因、`np5_01a_total_sites=217`）、README、receipt（verdict=PASS、site_count=78、pending_manual=0、policy 扫描 0 命中、re2_corrections 全闭环）、logs/selfcheck.txt、manifest 逐文件 sha256+bytes 自核；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM。
边界：写域为上述证据路径 + `scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py` + `.normify/**`；`src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/` 零改动；零 GPU、零窗；不改判据/参考/容差。
四门禁 + normify check；中文提交。
note: RE-2 复核 2 一般项（A-2 addenda 非 append；引文拆写规避扫描器）+ 1 低（policy_tool.landed 时点）+ 2 观察（mass_multiply 18 属 A-3；粒度混用）并入本卡第一节；B-1 为 B 批 78 站点 source 级。零 GPU。
